plugins.name: cdp5-gates
plugins.description: Read-only deterministic T1 skills per CDP5 §32.9: konzept-mapper, konzept-lint (gate plus score against the shipped maturity policy), ac-to-test-scaffold, konzept-model-api, test-gap, roadmap-drift, retro-memory-loop-check, wiki-lint, mcp-config-lint, secrets-scan, pii-scan, profile-check, cdp5-init, cdp5-reference. Reproducible (program, no LLM); the output is the evidence.

plugins.name: cdp5-agents
plugins.description: Project-independent CDP5 judgment agents (read-only): konzept-reviewer, review-verify, adversarial-auditor, threat-modeler, mcp-security-reviewer; shared worker contract via SubagentStart/SubagentStop hooks with usage log.

plugins.name: orbit-workflow
plugins.description: SessionStart hook that loads the latest Orbit report and the open FastNotes of the current project into every Claude Code session (startup, resume, clear, compact), with a local cache when Orbit is unreachable.
